TokenBudgetBasis.input_scale: Five unique requests; one local Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B query batch; each request must expose exactly 96 unique union candidates and 16 unique final-review candidates over 1,888 source records and 34,199 compiled objects.
TokenBudgetBasis.required_outputs: A raw execution receipt; canonical-family and raw-occurrence coverage; per-target source, compiled, union and final bounded-package completeness and ranks; earliest loss; residual route boundary; 4B, reranker and bounded-03C eligibility; and digest-bound private/public projections without Candidate or Evidence promotion.

TokenBudgetBasis.materiality_quality_risk: False positives can treat negated supply as a relationship, future or wrong-process yield as observed Dell HBM evidence, customer procurement as Dell company units, configuration prices as realized ASP, distant same-source objects as adjacent, or duplicated parent/slices as independent claims. False negatives can hide a material sentence lost by local compilation. Either error would distort the eventual report and source-closure plan.
TokenBudgetBasis.comparable_run_evidence: Immutable R3 executed the five-request 96-to-16 chain and independently passed its execution and privacy seal, but its fresh audit found one P1 units materiality error and one P2 semantic-guard family. TokenBudgetBasis.reasoning_profile: Non-generative deterministic validation plus one local CUDA/FP16 Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B query batch. Semantic classification uses canonical source families, absolute bounded adjacency, target-specific entity and direction rules, symmetric qualifier guards, seller and period roles, and exact material numeric or time anchors. No 4B model or reranker is invoked; this run only determines where later controlled routes are justified.
TokenBudgetBasis.stop_and_truncation: Fail before consumption on any Git, authority, predecessor, implementation, runtime, input, output-path, or attempt collision drift. After the consumption receipt is created there is no same-attempt retry. Fail on anything other than five unique requests, one local batch, exact 96 and 16 unique rank permutations per request, or zero network, model, provider, external, 4B, reranker, retry, mutation, promotion and closure counters. Never truncate required target, coverage, route, or integrity outputs.
